Insp… text:Place -> choice:Vibe -> join:Spec -> llm:Postcard prompt -> image:Postcard; returns image (muse-image/text-to-image, 3:2) saved to disk (file path in result). Runs on NanoGPT — $0.03 deposit per call, paid in Nano (XNO) — settles at actual model cost + 20%, change returned; no account needed. Example: Reviewed sample (https://nanoodle.com/examples/gallery/#night-market-postcard). An illustrated Raohe night-market postcard from the saved place and atmosphere inputs. Use it as creative artwork rather than a documentary record.
